records.text: Keras Wolfheart is an Arathi Basin battlemaster in Darnassus who politely refuses entry to adventurers who are not yet powerful enough.

Aethalas is a Warsong Gulch battlemaster who offers the chance to aid the Silverwing Sentinels in their fight there. He handles the battleground entry exchange and may warn that a character is not seasoned enough to enter.
Faelyssa is a humanoid in Darnassus.

Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker is an Explorers' League archaeologist who worries about the crew he sent to Darkshore after they went weeks without word. He believes recent discoveries in Khaz Modan reveal a powerful threat to Azeroth. A mysterious fossil reminds him of one shown by Flagongut at an Explorers' League conference, so he directs its delivery to Flagongut for investigation.
An Ancient of Lore.
An Ancient of War in Darnassus.

Fandral Staghelm is an arch druid who takes Teldrassil's problems as a personal burden and wants to restore his people's immortality. He credits his own leadership with saving his people, dismisses the Moonglade Cenarion Circle's criticism and delegates its requests for aid to Mathrengyl Bearwalker. He resents interruptions to his work and receives reports from the Oracle Tree.

Rellian Greenspyre is a druid in Darnassus studying the corruption afflicting Teldrassil’s timberlings. He examines seeds and tumors, recognizes when their taint is beyond his own ability to mend, and sends promising findings to his friend Denalan, whose skill with growing things may help the timberlings recover.
Kyrai supplies poisons in Darnassus.
Alaindia supplies reagents in Darnassus. Her reagent title and merchant service distinguish her as a source of spellworking materials.

Arias'ta Bladesinger is a warrior trainer who greets seekers of instruction in the art of war. Her conditional greeting addresses a student as “child” and judges whether the warrior's spirit is present, giving her instruction a discerning, mentor-like manner.

Elanaria is a night elf warrior instructor whose training begins with guarding Teldrassil’s sacred places. She tests a student’s resolve by sending them to defeat Vorlus Vilehoof, a satyr defiling a remote moonwell, and later directs them to recover the ore needed for a warrior’s weapon. She treats the moonwell’s cleansing as a defense of her people’s home, and regards the Shade of Elura’s release as a hard-won mercy.
Sildanair teaches the art of war and looks for a warrior’s spirit in prospective students.

Astarii Starseeker is a night elf priest trainer associated with the Temple of the Moon. She offers priestly instruction and greets visitors in Elune’s name. One petitioner asks that a recovered prayer to Elune be brought to her; Astarii’s response thanks the bearer for returning a lost soul to Elune, showing her role in receiving the prayer and honoring the soul’s return.
Jandria trains priests and teaches that the reason for helping those in need matters more than the method. Jandria directs learners to Ogtinc in Azshara to aid the Cenarion Circle.
Lariia trains priests and offers to share wisdom and knowledge.
Jeen’ra Nightrunner trains hunters and addresses visitors as “my child.”

Jocaste is a hunter trainer in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, known for her stern manner. She teaches hunters to train and guide their pets, including feeding and reviving them. She respects hunters who advance in their craft and expects respect in return.

Idriana is a banker at the Bank of Darnassus. The bank offers accounts and safety deposit boxes, and she handles deposit box access. She also processes a voucher authorizing a withdrawal from Gracina Spiritmight’s account.

Astaia is a fishing trainer. She can teach fishing skills and directs anglers who have outgrown her instruction to other sources of expertise, including Old Man Heming in Booty Bay and Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Me’lynn teaches tailoring and finds inspiration for new designs in a fine day.

Ainethil teaches alchemy and reports that a healing potion becomes less effective with repeated brewing despite unchanged ingredients. Ainethil concludes that the plants are changing, but does not know why or what they are becoming.
Lysheana serves as a guild master and greets visitors with a wish for Elune’s grace.

Syurna trains rogues and favors stealth when force and diplomacy fail. Concerned about the sickness affecting Teldrassil, Syurna seeks clues from Sethir the Ancient and suspects the corruption of Darkshore’s forests and rivers is spreading homeward. Syurna dismisses Jannok as a dolt for his persistent flower-sending, but recognizes that his courier might prove useful.
Cylania is a night elf armorer who sells armor.

Elissa Dumas is a portal trainer. She offers mage training in portal magic, describing it as a way to conjure a portal back to this place. Her recorded dialogue also includes a conditional response questioning a visitor's ability to understand the magic.

Dendrythis is a food and drink vendor. Visitors can browse their goods, and the native records also provide a questgiver interaction. The available evidence does not identify particular provisions or establish any quest's availability or outcome.
Elynna supplies tailoring goods. Visitors can browse her goods, while the native records also provide a questgiver interaction. The evidence does not specify her stock or identify any quest details.
Jaeana is a meat vendor. Visitors can browse her goods, and the native records also provide a questgiver interaction. No particular meat or quest details are specified in the available evidence.

Ellandrieth is a general goods merchant. Visitors can browse the goods she offers, and the native records also provide a questgiver interaction. The available evidence does not specify her inventory or any quest details.

Merelyssa is a blade merchant. Visitors can browse her goods, and the native records also identify a repair service. The available evidence does not specify her stock or establish the availability or scope of repairs.
Anadyia is a robe vendor. Her role in the local trade is to offer robes for browsing, giving visitors a direct source for that kind of clothing.
Landria is a bow merchant, with bows as her specific trade. Visitors can browse her goods, making her a local source for ranged weapons.
Vinasia is a cloth armor merchant. Her trade centers on cloth armor, giving visitors seeking that type of equipment a focused place to browse.
Melea is a mail armor merchant. She offers a focused source for mail armor, helping visitors browse equipment in that armor category.
Ealyshia Dewwhisper is a two-handed weapon merchant. Her trade centers on two-handed weapons, giving visitors a focused place to browse that equipment.
Fyrenna is a food and drink vendor. Her trade supplies visitors with a place to browse food and drink for their travels.
Ariyell Skyshadow is a weapon merchant.
Firodren Mooncaller teaches herbalism.
Dorion is a hunter trainer who guides aspiring hunters toward taming companions, referring them to Dazalar in Dolanaar and Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
Lairn provides banking services.
Garryeth provides banking services.
Alegorn is a cooking trainer who offers training. He speaks of cooking as a lifelong pursuit and directs aspiring cooks to Shandrina for the Expert Cookbook.

Dannelor teaches First Aid in Darnassus. His training points beyond his own lessons: he speaks of Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen in Theramore and Deneb Walker in Stromgarde as sources for further instruction.

Telonis is a master leatherworker and trainer in Darnassus. Pratt, his former student, respects his skill and judgment; Telonis accepts Pratt’s praise of another leatherworker and completes that student’s Wild Leather training with a rare cloak pattern. He teaches craftsmen to work with leather’s natural qualities rather than force it.
Taladan teaches enchanting in Darnassus. He presents his craft as a skill earned by the worthy, and offers training to those who seek to learn.

Erion Shadewhisper trains rogues in Darnassus. When Stormwind Intelligence requests a promising recruit by name, Erion directs the recruit to Renzik “The Shiv” at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. Erion warns that the journey is taxing and perilous but values the training opportunity, encouraging the recruit to branch out into the wider world. Erion welcomes young rogues and declines to train other classes.

Anishar is a rogue trainer. His conversation options cover rogue training, unlearning talents, and information about Dual Talent Specialization. He also offers a letter through his conversation options.
Chardryn deals in herbalism supplies. Visitors can open a goods list to browse what is available, making Chardryn a practical stop for gathering profession supplies.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker trains druids in Darnassus and teaches preservation of nature’s balance. He guides students through druidic trials and oversees the cultivation and supply of Tharlendris seeds for Morrowgrain research, keeping routine returns away from the busy Arch Druid. He also handles sensitive Cenarion matters: a report about the Emerald Dream leads him to caution that its condition is not as the druids believed, and that such affairs belong to them alone.

Denatharion is a druid trainer in Darnassus who welcomes fellow druids and offers training. He speaks approvingly of Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm’s leadership and Teldrassil’s renewal, dismissing rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle as loose talk.

Fylerian Nightwing is a druid trainer who welcomes visitors seeking instruction and offers talent-related services. He speaks warmly of Cenarius and presents Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm as Teldrassil’s guide, dismissing rumors of strife in the Cenarion Circle as loose talk.

Cyroen is a reagent supplier whose wares can be browsed. The available records identify her by that trade and show a separate questgiver interaction, but provide no dialogue to establish her views or personality.

Talaelar sells fish, with a goods-browsing interaction recorded for visitors. The available evidence establishes this trade and identifies Talaelar as a local vendor, but offers no dialogue or further personal detail.
Voloren supplies fishing goods. Visitors have a goods-browsing interaction, while the available records provide no dialogue or further detail about Voloren’s character.
Fyldan supplies cooking goods, with a goods-browsing interaction recorded for visitors. The available evidence identifies this trade but gives no dialogue or further personal detail about Fyldan.

Saenorion supplies leatherworking goods, with a goods-browsing interaction recorded for visitors. The available evidence identifies this trade but gives no dialogue or further personal detail about Saenorion.
Ulthir is an alchemy-supplies vendor in the area. Ask to browse his goods for alchemy supplies.
Vaean is an enchanting-supplies vendor in the area. Ask to browse her goods for enchanting supplies.
Mythrin'dir sells trade supplies. Ask to browse his goods for the trade goods he carries.
Yldan is a bag merchant in the area. Ask to browse his goods for bags.
Kieran is a weapon merchant in the area. Ask to browse his goods for weapons.
Glorandiir is an axe merchant in the area. Ask to browse his goods for axes.
Mythidan is a mace and staff merchant in Darnassus, serving adventurers who come to browse his goods. His specialty is weapons for those seeking a mace or staff.
Andrus is a staff merchant in Darnassus, serving adventurers who come to browse his goods. His specialty is staves for those looking to equip themselves.
Turian is a thrown-weapons merchant in Darnassus, serving adventurers who come to browse his goods. His specialty is weapons meant to be thrown.
Cyridan is a leather armor merchant in Darnassus, serving adventurers who come to browse his goods. His specialty is leather armor for those seeking such equipment.
Caynrus is a shield merchant in Darnassus, serving adventurers who come to browse his goods. His specialty is shields for those seeking protection in their travels.

Mydrannul is a general-goods merchant in Darnassus. He says it is his honor to provide for adventurers, whom he regards as heroes in the making. He also offers help for a task involving Nessa Shadowsong, a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village; the task's account describes Nessa's request, not Mydrannul's own.
A frost saber companion found in Darnassus.
Nightshade is Jeen'ra's pet in Darnassus.
Shadow is Dorion's pet in Darnassus.
Darnassus sentinels direct visitors to services around the city. This sentinel offers directions to places including the auction house and bank.
A Darnassian elemental protector in Darnassus.
Treshala Fallowbrook is Heralath’s wife in Darnassus. After receiving his pendant and news of his death, she grieves deeply, resolves to carry on his work, and asks to mourn in solitude.

Lelanai is Darnassus’s saber handler, presenting the nightsaber as a prized Teldrassil mount and noting the Sentinel Army’s longstanding reliance on these companions. Her sales greeting invites prospective buyers to examine her selection.

Jartsam is a Darnassus riding trainer who teaches Tiger Riding for a fee. His training greeting stresses that the lesson requires sufficient gold; a pamphlet from him also advertises riding lessons and mount purchases.

Dawnwatcher Selgorm serves the Argent Dawn in Darnassus, working to strengthen the order and thwart evil encroaching on Kalimdor. He asks for help against Twilight Lord Kelris, whose cultists allied with naga and sacrificed innocents to Aku’mai; Selgorm says Kelris had eluded them for years and was thought dead or missing.
Argent Guard Manados represents the Argent Dawn in Darnassus, asking for proof of efforts against the Twilight’s Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. He commends those who return from the campaign.

Dawnwatcher Shaedlass serves the Argent Dawn by gathering information about threats around Blackfathom Deeps. With her other scouts occupied, she asks for help finding Argent Guard Thaelrid, who has not reported back from investigating activity there.
Ellaercia is a guild tabard designer who offers guild crest creation.

Brogun Stoneshield is an Alterac Valley battlemaster. His greeting invites experienced combatants to join the battleground, while another response cautions that less experienced characters may not be ready.
Shalumon is a tabard vendor. Visitors can tell Shalumon they have lost a Blood Knight Tabard, Tabard of the Hand, Tabard of the Protector or Green Trophy Tabard of the Illidari.
Crildor is a humanoid found in Darnassus.

Lotherias is a Darnassian leatherworker with orders for supplies to meet adventurers' needs. His Moonglow Vest quest dialogue describes a leatherworking pattern he can teach, and its reward text praises careful craftsmanship.

Mathiel is a smith in Darnassus, eager to apply colleague Furen Longbeard’s discoveries to new armor research. Mathiel also cares deeply for gnome friend Klockmort Spannerspan, asking allies to help with a dangerous Gnomeregan mission while remaining behind. Mathiel crafts weapons and armor.
Eladriel is a skinning trainer.

Innkeeper Saelienne offers lodging and goods at her Darnassus inn. During Hallow’s End, she joins the Trick or Treat custom and gives marzipan to visitors who dance for her. She welcomes the tradition with a joke about her own dancing and sends her best wishes to a sick child. She also directs interested adventurers to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm for the Cenarion Circle’s research project, though she says she does not know its details.
Corand, a humanoid in Darnassus.

Priestess A'moora serves at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She explains that Lady Sathrah, once beloved of Elune, has fallen into madness, and directs the effort to end the spider's suffering and offer her silvery spinnerets to Elune at the temple fountain. A'moora regards the sacrifice as a hope for Sathrah's rebirth and peace.

Darnath Bladesinger is a warrior trainer in Darnassus who offers instruction in the art of war. His guidance also sends warriors to test themselves among their peers at Fray Island and to speak with a fallen Horde hero about a warrior's honor.

Sister Aquinne is a novice priestess who asks visitors to seek Priestess A'moora at the Temple of the Moon. She describes a once-great forest creature in need of help and points toward A'moora for an explanation of the difficult task.

Gracina Spiritmight is a night elf scholar and historian who studies Azeroth's unusual life forms. She regards the silithid as a grave threat to both Horde and Alliance, condemning the Alliance's fixation on the Horde and Fandral Staghelm's dismissal of her warnings. She is willing to revise her own theory: Un'Goro may not be their origin, and she suspects a stronger presence elsewhere.

Tyrande Whisperwind is Darnassus's High Priestess of Elune, receiving reports and aid for the city's defense. She welcomes capable adventurers with warmth and humility, and calls on them to lend their strength when the world tree faces conflict. She trusts her priests to channel a Light-infused artifact against the Lich King's forces and hopes peace may one day extend to another world tree in the north.

Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a Sentinel commander in Darnassus who took up the work of the missing priestess Velinde Starsong. She guards information about Velinde's departure, requiring good reason to share details, yet trusts that Velinde may still return and chooses to seek contact with her. Learning that Velinde is gone, Thyn'tel recalls their friendship with the High Priestess and is troubled that the Scythe of Elune has left the goddess's servants.
Sentinel Dalia Sunblade is a sentinel found in Darnassus.
Shylenai is an owl trainer in Darnassus who offers goods for browsing.
Tolon is an auctioneer in Darnassus who provides auction services.
Golothas is an auctioneer in Darnassus who provides auction services.

Jenal is a ditch digger in the Cenarion Enclave who handles logistics for the Cenarion Circle's Un'Goro soil study. He calls himself a visionary and resents being kept in obscurity, warning visitors not to step in the dirt. He speaks of conspiracies.
Alassin is a stable master in the Cenarion Enclave. He offers pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Silvaria is a pet trainer who helps hunters with their companions. Her service covers training and untraining pets, and she makes clear that her help is for hunters and their pets.

Herald Moonstalker presents himself as a public herald, greeting visitors with the latest news from both continents and beyond. His formal proclamations call on able heroes to heed regional appeals and direct them to the named officials for details, such as Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm or Commander Ashlam Valorfist.

Milla Fairancora is an apprentice alchemist who welcomes visitors with an Elune-adore greeting, addressing them as brother or sister. Her warm welcome gives her alchemical role a personal, welcoming touch.

Sylvanna Forestmoon is an apprentice alchemist who teaches that small changes to a potion's ingredients can alter it fundamentally. She counsels patience and precision, presenting those habits as useful beyond alchemy.
Trianna is an apprentice tailor who finds weaving a way to clear the mind. Her brief reflection links her craft with calm and mental focus.
Lalina Summermoon is an apprentice enchanter who credits the Goddess with granting her wisdom. She is willing to pass that wisdom on, while leaving its sharing to the Goddess's will.

Faldron is an apprentice leatherworker who mentors Darianna. He sees promise in her energy, strength and agility, and worries she may be called to fight before she has learned enough. He is eager to teach her quickly.
Darianna is an apprentice leatherworker who welcomes an interest in sewing with leather. Darianna calls Faldron and Telonis true artists and hopes to learn much from them.

Priestess Alathea is a priest trainer who offers wisdom and knowledge and greets visitors with a blessing in Elune's name. She directs aid for the Cenarion Circle to Ogtinc in Azshara, expressing the principle that helping those in need matters more than how the help is given.
Sarin Starlight is a named individual found in Darnassus.
Jareth Wildwoods is a named individual found in Darnassus.
Ilyenia Moonfire is a weapon master who offers training in various weapons. She says the grace with which she fights cannot be taught, while weapon use can be.
A striped frostsaber identified for riding, this beast has the striped coat that distinguishes it from the spotted frostsaber.
A spotted frostsaber identified for riding, this beast’s spotted coat distinguishes it from the striped frostsabers.
A striped nightsaber identified for riding, this beast’s dark feline kind distinguishes it from the striped and spotted frostsabers.
Huntress Skymane is an elite quest giver. When combat begins, she casts Hooked Net.
Huntress Ravenoak is an elite quest giver. When combat begins, she casts Hooked Net.
Huntress Leafrunner is an elite quest giver. When combat begins, she casts Hooked Net.
Swift Mistsaber is a saber creature.
Swift Frostsaber is a saber creature.
Swift Stormsaber is a saber creature.

Raedon Duskstriker is the Alliance cloth quartermaster who asks for donations to replenish the community's cloth reserves. He frames the shortage as a shared hardship and thanks contributors warmly, presenting donated cloth as help for the night elves. His recorded work centers on this cloth drive.

Elder Bladeswift speaks of the stars as beacons of hope and strength for ages to come. He turns that celestial image into a reflection on finding answers to earthly mysteries, giving his words a thoughtful, elder tone.
Auctioneer Silva’las offers auction services.
Auctioneer Cazarez runs an auction service.

Master Sergeant Moonshadow serves as the Alliance War Effort Recruiter for preparations against Ahn'Qiraj. Moonshadow urges adventurers to help gather supplies and directs them to Field Marshal Snowfall, who is in charge of the effort. The appeal is earnest and focused on the coming war.

Officer Lunalight acts for Darnassus as a Commendation Officer. Lunalight accepts Alliance Commendation Signets in different quantities, records the deeds represented by them, and says that sets of ten bring the most beneficial exchange. The officer's words frame this service as recognition for duty to Darnassus.
Aldris Fourclouds is a named humanoid who offers quests.
The Argent Recruiter represents the Argent Dawn in a recruiting role.

Lieutenant Beitha is an Argent Dawn officer at the Scourge front near Darnassus. She calls for help against the undead and asks visitors to investigate the strange runic circles and report what they learn. Her concern about the voices linked to those circles reflects the danger she sees in the Scourge's magic.

Emissary Valustraa represents the draenei within the Alliance and serves as a mage trainer. Valustraa believes the Alliance's peoples have much to teach one another, and sends a traveler to Astranaar to offer help to its night elf inhabitants. The role joins practical instruction with diplomacy between Alliance communities.
Night elf commoners mark the Lunar Festival by seeking their elders' wisdom, and celebrate Midsummer with greetings, shopping and fireworks.

Enlae is an Eye of the Storm battlemaster who describes the conflict in Outland as a fight between Draenei forces and their Alliance allies against the Horde. Enlae invites Alliance combatants to join the effort and directs them to the battleground, presenting the contest as a way to help turn the battle in their favor.
Fima Five-Fingers is an arena battlemaster for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. The shared greeting challenges aspirants to prove their ability and dismisses those judged unready as wasting time.

The Teldrassil Pink Elekk is a Brewfest apparition reported as a hallucination. It can be seen while drunk or wearing Synthebrew Goggles; ordinary weapons pass through it, and Goldark Snipehunter supplies a device to dispel such elekks.

Nivara Bladedancer is the Strand of the Ancients battlemaster. Nivara calls for soldiers to prevent the Horde from using the strand’s hidden secrets against their side, while advising inexperienced volunteers to grow stronger before joining the battle.
Feyden Darkin teaches inscription.
Illianna Moonscribe sells inscription supplies.

The Cheerful Night Elf Spirit in Darnassus’s graveyard enjoys visiting friends and family, celebrating and sharing old stories. Having eaten everything prepared for the visit, the spirit politely asks for more Bread of the Dead and gratefully offers a small holiday gift in return.

Isaac Allerton is a Pilgrim's Bounty food vendor and quest contact associated with the Darnassus feast. His work there centers on keeping food supplies moving to the celebrants, and he greets returning visitors to Darnassus.
Ikaneba Summerset serves as a Pilgrim's Bounty vendor associated with the feast in Darnassus. Visitors can browse her goods.
Mary Allerton is a cooking trainer who says Pilgrim's Bounty usually brings her many new students. She also helps keep the feast tables stocked and calls pumpkin pie one of Isaac's favorites.
Landuen Moonclaw is a Battlemaster who frames battleground fighting as service to the Alliance. He expects aspiring fighters to gain experience before entering a battleground.
Terrance Matterly is the Alliance's Isle of Conquest battlemaster. He frames the island's resources as valuable and urges others to keep them from the Horde by joining the fight.
A ghostly night elf celebrant returns to visit friends and family, celebrating and sharing old stories. Reunion and remembrance are at the heart of this gathering.
Rukua is a paladin trainer who describes her path through purity and righteousness in the Light. She addresses another believer as brother or sister, expressing fellowship through shared devotion.
The Bountiful Barrel holds Pilgrim's Bounty supplies and serves as a vendor; visitors can browse its goods.
Arcanist Dulial is a Wintergrasp battle-mage who directs combatants to support their forces and handles entry into the battle. Her greetings address visitors by class.

Mordent Evenshade is a Highborne mage returned from centuries of separation, seeking an accord with the kaldorei in Darnassus. He presses for an audience with Tyrande, believing his people’s knowledge may one day be needed. The moonwell recalls the Well of Eternity: he admires its beauty but says he does not seek to use it. He acknowledges past mistakes and says the Highborne are ready to emerge from hiding.

Sentinel Stillbough is a wary kaldorei sentinel who refuses a Highborne audience and warns Mordent that his people remain unwelcome because of the War of the Ancients. Stillbough guards the moonwell’s power from an exile’s use and demands vigilance.

Kwee Q. Peddlefeet is an official Crown Chemical Co. mascot for the Charitable Charms program. Kwee offers Lovely Charm Collector’s Kits and promotes turning gathered charms into bracelets for friends or leaders, or exchanging them for Love Tokens. The event pitch makes Kwee an upbeat promoter of affectionate gifts; one offered errand concerns a bracelet for Tyrande.

This Dungeonmaster is a Brewfest brewer whose employees were roughed up and whose brew was taken by Corin Direbrew and his Dark Iron cronies. He insists it was not his fault that Direbrew was left out of the competition, calls him a madman, and wants someone to stop him.

place_records.text: You are in Darnassus, Alliance land on the continent of Kalimdor. Its five districts are the Cenarion Enclave, Craftsmen's Terrace, Warrior's Terrace, The Temple Gardens and Tradesmen's Terrace, where druids, warriors, priests and traders work. The forests of Teldrassil are sick, and druids here study the corruption spreading through them.

You are in the Cenarion Enclave, a district of Darnassus. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is among the druids here, and trainers teach hunters, rogues and druids their crafts. Jocaste, a stern hunter trainer, respects hunters who advance and expects respect in return. Rellian Greenspyre, a druid, studies the corruption afflicting the timberlings of Teldrassil.

You are in Craftsmen's Terrace, a district of Darnassus where the Argent Dawn has representatives. Argent Guard Manados runs a campaign against the Twilight's Hammer at Blackfathom Deeps. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass has her other scouts occupied, and Argent Guard Thaelrid has not reported back from investigating activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Innkeeper Saelienne keeps the district's inn.

You are in Warrior's Terrace, a district of Darnassus where warriors learn the art of war. Darnath Bladesinger and Arias'ta Bladesinger teach here, and Sildanair looks for a warrior's spirit in students. A satyr named Vorlus Vilehoof still defiles a remote moonwell southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, a Sentinel commander, guards what is known of the missing priestess Velinde Starsong's departure.

You are in The Temple Gardens, a district of Darnassus where priests and mages learn their crafts. Priestess A'moora says Lady Sathrah, a spider once beloved of Elune, has fallen into madness. Gracina Spiritmight, a scholar, regards the silithid as a grave threat. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker worries about a crew he sent to Darkshore, which has gone weeks without word.

You are in Tradesmen's Terrace, a district of Darnassus given over to trade. Merchants offer mail and cloth armor, bows, two-handed weapons, robes and fish, and Astaia teaches fishing. The auction house and repairs are here too.
